_: Objs this repo built or imported with nothing in the game that gives one out.
why: Per-round specs already carry their own: slayerhelmspec.json for the sourceless helmet colours, petspec.json for the pets whose skill is not built yet. This file is for everything else. tools/obtainable.py reads all three, so an obj here that GAINS a source is reported as a disagreement rather than excused forever - which is what happened to the bottomless compost bucket and the Thread of Elidinis, both of which were in this file until they were given real sources and had to come out of it.
the_shape_of_this_list: Most entries are a CATEGORY, keyed on one member with the rest under 'also' - because most of these objs have no source for one shared reason, and 100 copies of that reason is 100 places for it to go stale. obtainable.py checks every name under 'also' for disagreement exactly as it checks the key, so grouping costs no coverage.
what_a_why_is_for: Not to excuse the obj. To stop the next round re-investigating it: every one of these took a grep and a judgement, and the judgement is the part worth keeping.
not_a_source_is: objs that DO have a source, but that something also adds in a way that is not one - a swap, a refund, a restyle. 'ignore' inside an objs entry only helps while the obj is sourceless, and both of the objs below stopped being sourceless: the bottomless bucket is now found while farming and the Thread of Elidinis comes out of a hard clue. Without this section their swap and refund would silently become their 'source', and deleting the real one would leave the sweep still calling them obtainable - which is the regression the script-grained exemption was invented to stop. Same format as 'ignore': 'file.rs2:script,header'.

not_a_source_why.bottomless_bucket: the restyle swaps the empty bucket for the filled one and back to keep the inventory icon honest; each add has a matching delete, so it moves a bucket rather than making one
not_a_source_why.thread_of_elidinis: Revert hands back the thread the upgrade spent, which is a refund and not a source: you cannot revert a pouch you never stitched

ignore_is: the scripts whose inv_add of this obj is a swap rather than a source, as 'file.rs2:script,header'. Named at script grain on purpose: a whole-file exemption would also excuse a real source added to that file later.

macro_quiz_food1.why: THE QUIZ MASTER IS IMPLEMENTED and he does not hand these out. The ten are the quiz's own answer pictures - two each of food, weapon, armour, tool and jewel - and macro_quiz_ask picks three per question and passes them to ~multiobj3, which draws them with if_setobject and returns which one was clicked. The prize is macro_quiz_mystery_box, and that is obtainable. The ten have no source of their own in OSRS either, so this is correct rather than unfinished

evil_bob_amulet_of_manspeak.osrs_source: Evil Bob's own neck, in the random event on his island
evil_bob_amulet_of_manspeak.why: EVIL BOB IS IMPLEMENTED and the four fishlike things came off this list on 2026-10-15: the cooked pair is what the net catches, and using one on the fire swaps it for the uncooked one. The amulet never was a reward - the event's header quotes the wiki on it, "Evil Bob wore a manspeak amulet, which is how players are able to converse with him", so the one in the cache is his. Nothing in OSRS hands a player one either

macro_digger_apron.osrs_source: nothing: the coffin's contents and the symbol stones are the Gravedigger random event's own furniture in OSRS too
macro_digger_apron.why: THE GRAVEDIGGER IS IMPLEMENTED and the five zombie pieces came off this list on 2026-10-15 - macro_digger_reward_obj is read by the event's reward branch and pays one out per completion. What is left is the puzzle itself and none of it can be held: the fifteen grave goods and the skull and the pile of bones are put in macro_digger_coffin_inv, which is only ever cleared, filled and transmitted to the coffin interface, and the five "Its a symbol" stones are put on an interface by ~macro_digger_stone_show so the player can read which trade the grave belongs to. Both tables are named in obtainable.py's STORAGE_LISTS and the inv in its DISPLAY_INVS for exactly this reason

macro_cube_redtriangle.osrs_source: nothing: these are not items in OSRS either
macro_cube_redtriangle.why: THE STRANGE BOX EVENT IS IMPLEMENTED, and it does not use these. The 15 colour-and-shape cubes at ids 3063-3091 are drawn by scripts/interfaces/macro_cube.if as MODELS - model=obj_macro_cube_redtriangle - never handed out as objs, and the 15 unnamed objs interleaved between them at the even ids are their cache twins, which the unpacker names whoopsie_objNNNN because the cache gives them no name at all. The objs the event really does hand out are macro_cube and the 7000-series, and those are obtainable
macro_cube_redtriangle.note: a loose grep for macro_cube_redtriangle in the .if file finds a hit and looks like a source. It is the model name with obj_ in front of it. Match on a word boundary

magic_secateurs.why: A DUPLICATE, AND THE TRAP IS THE POINT. This build already has the working magic secateurs under the name the 377 cache gives them - fairy_enchanted_secateurs, id 7409 - and that is the one farming_actions.rs2 reads for the 10% harvest bonus and farming_useitem.rs2 reads for pruning. magic_secateurs (8109) came in with a later-cache import of items already present, does nothing, and sits one autocomplete away from the one that works
magic_secateurs.why_not_deleted: removing an obj id is not free: a character who was handed one with ::give would be holding an item the server no longer defines, and dropping the pack/obj.pack line leaves a nameless default obj at 8109 rather than closing the gap. The trap is closed by a check instead - poh_battery group 66 fails if any script names it - which costs nothing and cannot corrupt a save

rotten_net.osrs_source: nothing: it is a 2004-era item with no source in OSRS either
rotten_net.why: a cache-native item this repo has no content for. It is also the obj that sits one id past the law talisman, which is why the unpacker called the law talisman note "cert_law_talisman" and withdrawing one used to hand over a Rotten net - see claude/certificates-and-notes.md

soul_talisman.osrs_source: a drop from anything that drops talismans, for the Soul altar
soul_talisman.why: there is no soul altar in the 377 cache - the Runecrafting altars stop at nature, law and cosmic. A talisman for an altar that does not exist has nowhere to be used, so giving it a source would be worse than leaving it out

broken_tiara.osrs_source: nothing in OSRS: it is an unused cache item
broken_tiara.why: a cache-native item with no content anywhere, here or in OSRS. Runecrafting tiaras in this build do not break

castlewars_catapult.osrs_source: nothing: it is a scenery item, not something a player holds
castlewars_catapult.why: Castle Wars is implemented here but its catapult is not, and this obj is the cache's inventory record for a thing that in OSRS is a loc you operate rather than an item you carry. It has no place in a pack even if the catapult were built

burnt_uw_oomlie.osrs_source: nothing: an oomlie cooked without a palm leaf is destroyed outright, so OSRS never gives you a burnt one either
burnt_uw_oomlie.why: the burnt version exists in the cache because every other cookable has one. Cooking an oomlie wrong in this build follows OSRS and destroys it, so this obj is correctly unreachable - giving it a source would be a bug, not a fix

ardougne_cloak_1.osrs_source: the twelve achievement diaries, one reward per set per tier, from the diary taskmaster once that tier is complete
ardougne_cloak_1.why: There is no achievement diary system in this build - no tasks, no taskmasters, no completion varps, nothing. The twelve reward sets were imported ahead of it on 2026-09-21 and diary_rewards.obj says so in its own header ("The items only: their effects - teleports, daily recharges, gathering bonuses - are a later round, one set at a time"). THE ELITE TIER CAME OFF THIS LIST ON 2026-10-13: nine of the twelve tier-4 items are sold by the Vote clerk for vote points and wired to their effects, and Explorer's ring 4 was sold there already, so those ten have a source and do not belong here. What is left is tiers 1 to 3, plus the two tier-4 sets that stayed out - the western banner, which was declined, and Rada's blessing, whose teleports are both Great Kourend and there is no map for it. Those are still items waiting on a feature rather than mistakes, and still specced together because they would arrive together: a round that builds the diary itself takes the rest off this list

moonclan_manual.osrs_source: a Lunar Isle flavour item read during Lunar Diplomacy
moonclan_manual.why: IT CARRIES iop1=Read AND NOTHING HANDLES IT, and the lunar spellbook it is flavour for is already in the game through lunar_spells.dbrow. It was imported from the 474 cache with the rest of lunar_items.obj and still carries that file's "TODO by hand" line, which is the honest state of it
moonclan_manual.note: THE THREE EMERALD ITEMS WERE HERE UNTIL THE LADY ZAY CHAPTER LANDED. lunar_emerald_lens, lunar_emerald_lantern and lunar_emerald_lantern_lit waited on a ship whose every stair was an unhandled Climb op, so no deck could be walked and the jinx symbols could not be reached; lunar_ladyzay.rs2 built stages 20 to 70 and the lens is ground, fitted and lit there now. They came off this list the day it did - which is the whole point of the sweep reporting a gained source as a disagreement rather than excusing it

saradomin_platebody.osrs_source: a hard clue scroll's rare table, which is where the 377 cache's own four come from now
saradomin_platebody.why: FOUR MORE DUPLICATES, AND THE SAME TRAP AS magic_secateurs. Saradomin's platebody, platelegs, plateskirt and kiteshield are in this build twice: the 377 cache carries them at 2661..2667 as rune_platebody_saradomin and its three siblings, and these four came in with the 2026-10-04 import of Old School's own 510 clue uniques, which named every item the Old School way and so did not see that the cache already had them. The cache ones are what the game is wired to - param=saradominitem and param=gwd_prot_saradomin for Saradomin's door in God Wars, tier40.rs2's Dragon Slayer gate on the platebody, animmag.enum, and all four stored in the costume room chest - and these four carry none of it. The hard rare table handed these out until 2026-10-15, so the Saradomin armour a clue gave you was the half that God Wars did not recognise and the chest would not take; it names the cache's four now. The full helm was never duplicated, which is why it was always right
saradomin_platebody.why_not_deleted: the same reason magic_secateurs is not deleted: removing an obj id is not free. A character handed one with ::give would be holding an item the server no longer defines, and dropping the pack/obj.pack line leaves a nameless default obj at that id rather than closing the gap. poh_battery group 55 is what closes the trap - it re-derives the costume chest's list from the reward tables, so a table row naming one of these four again goes red at once

rune_heraldic_kiteshield1.osrs_source: a clue scroll's rare table, which is where the *_shield_h1..h5 fifteen come from
rune_heraldic_kiteshield1.why: FIFTEEN MORE DUPLICATES, from the same 2026-10-04 import as the Saradomin four. The 377 cache carries the heraldic kiteshields as rune/adamant/black_heraldic_kiteshield1..5, and the import of Old School's 510 clue uniques brought them in again as *_shield_h1..h5, because Old School names them "Rune shield (h1)" and the importer had no way to see the cache already had them. Unlike the Saradomin four, NEITHER RECORD CARRIES A PARAM OR A GATE THE OTHER LACKS - both are complete, with the same stats and their own models - so the tie broke on the only thing that matters: the import's fifteen are what the clue tables hand out and what the collection log tracks, and the cache's fifteen are what nothing gives any more. The costume room chest held the cache's fifteen until 2026-10-15, which was fifteen slots that could never be filled; it holds the obtainable fifteen now, and the Defence skill guide's two icons point at them too
rune_heraldic_kiteshield1.why_not_deleted: the same reason the duplicate magic secateurs are not deleted: removing an obj id is not free, and a character handed one with ::give would be holding an item the server no longer defines. poh_battery group 55 is what closes the trap - it re-derives the chest's list from the reward tables, so a chest row naming one of these fifteen again goes red at once
